A photorealistic television news anchor speaks directly to camera in a modern broadcast studio. The anchor and studio remain exactly as the reference start frame: same man, bald head, trimmed styled beard, dark navy suit, white shirt, dark tie, seated at the curved desk on the left of the frame, same lighting, same navy-blue-and-cyan newsroom, same rear displays. The glass hologram panel on the right of the frame stays in place. Hologram screen timeline, clip length 11.5 seconds, speech starts at 0 seconds. 0.0 to 0.5 seconds: the AI News Desk logo on the blue holographic screen, exactly as in the reference start frame. 0.5 to 3.0 seconds: the logo fades out slowly; the screen stays empty, plain blue glass with its thin glowing blue border, no picture, no text. 3.0 to 7.0 seconds: a glowing earth appears in the centre of the screen, and the electric logo line runs around the globe in one steady circle; no letters, no numbers, no flags. 7.0 to 7.5 seconds: the earth fades out and the original logo fades back in at the exact same size, position and brightness as the start frame. 7.5 to 11.5 seconds: the original logo holds, unchanged, until the end of the clip. The screen content stays inside the glowing border and never rises above the top rail; the desk reflection follows the screen; nothing else in the studio changes. At same time The anchor says exactly, in natural English, at a natural, unhurried pace, in an authoritative and informative news presenter tone, clear and easy to understand, never rushed, positive: "Welcome to A I News Desk. I am Raphael, and Every day, I bring you the headlines from all fields of A I. The tech, The money, The people, and the tools shaping our world. 90 seconds. starting now!" at the last second of the speech, when  it is the end of the sentence he puts his hands on the table and go back to the same position he started <reference image 01>.
He holds steady professional news energy. He stays the same person in one continuous stable broadcast. In the final second he settles and rests his hands together on the desk.
Static camera, locked framing, no camera movement. Natural subtle head and hand movement only. Accurate lip synchronization to the spoken words. Natural eyes, natural skin.

slots.symbol: a small glowing factory building with a single gear floating beside it, simple text-free symbol
slots.script: In business. French equipment maker Schneider Electric is buying factory software firm P T C. Regulators still have to approve the deal.

slots.symbol: a small glowing envelope with a fishing hook hanging above it, simple text-free symbol
slots.script: In security. Hackers posing as A I firm an-thropic's staff sent malware to A I policy experts. Researchers tie the hackers to China's government.

slots.symbol: a small glowing computer chip with a plain upward arrow beside it, simple text-free symbol
slots.script: In manufacturing. Chip giant T S M C is reported to plan another price rise next year. Demand for its newest chips is said to outrun supply.

slots.symbol: a small glowing four-rotor drone with a simple shield shape beneath it, text-free symbol
slots.script: In robotics. Germany is paying for tens of thousands of drones, built in Ukraine. Each hunts down Russian attack drones; the exact number is not yet given.

slots.symbol: a small glowing open box with a simple brain shape rising out of it, text-free symbol
slots.script: In new models. N-vidia-backed start-up Reflection is said to be readying an open A I model. Open means anyone can run it; nothing has shipped yet.

slots.symbol: a small glowing pill capsule under a simple magnifying glass, text-free symbol
slots.script: In health. A Stanford team had thirty seven thousand A I agents read old drug trials. The agents found a clue to safer drugs; no lab has tested it.

slots.symbol: a small glowing hamburger with a blank price tag hanging from it, simple text-free and number-free symbol
slots.script: In daily life. McDonald's reportedly uses A I to set menu prices in America. It calls the tool optional; some store owners say they feel pushed.

slots.symbol: a small glowing pizza slice with a simple heart floating above it, text-free symbol
slots.script: And something lighter. Munchy's Pizza, a Florida family shop, promised never to use A I. The promise drew tens of thousands of people online.

slots.symbol: a small glowing stack of papers with a bookmark ribbon on top, simple text-free symbol
slots.script: Also in the full report. I B M researchers estimate a quantum chip beat a supercomputer in one test. A I gun turrets are said to guard Kyiv.

slots.symbol: a small glowing stack of coins with a simple rising zigzag line above it, text-free and number-free symbol
slots.script: And for the bigger picture: hopes for A I prop up tech shares. Yet U S borrowing costs are the highest since two thousand two. Watch if they stay this high; the A I rally depends on that.
Those were today's headlines in ninety seconds. For more detailed coverage, read our daily news cards. Thank you for tuning in, and we'll see you tomorrow.
